events.name: 2026 FAMU Homecoming Concert

presales.name: 1887 Promo
presales.description: Celebrate Founders Day 2026 by purchasing a ticket to an unforgettable night of music, pride, and Rattler tradition! Secure your tickets now for the 2026 Homecoming Concert and join the FAMUly for the hottest concert event of the year.

events.info: HOMEcoming: There is No Place Like The Hill Get ready to come HOME for an unforgettable night of music, culture and celebration! HOMEcoming brings an explosive lineup featuring the raw energy of Belly Gang Kushington, hip-hop icon T.I., R&B powerhouse Summer Walker and chart-topping rapper Gunna. From the first beat to the final encore, expect heavy bass, electrifying performances, a fly crowd and the kind of energy that turns a concert into a full experience. This is where Rattlers reconnect, friends celebrate, hometown pride takes center stage and the culture comes alive under the lights. Whether you are returning to The Hill or experiencing FAMU Homecoming for the first time, this is the night you do not want to miss. BELLY GANG KUSHINGTON * SUMMER WALKER * T.I.* GUNNA One night. One stage. One unforgettable HOMEcoming. Pull up. Show out. Come HOME, because there is no place like The Hill.
events.pleaseNote: This is a reserved seat show. General admission seating will be behind the stage only.
